# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# oe_cri2.16 — W4 Audit & Telemetry Readout (Dev Panel Page 75)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_cri2.16 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cri2.16.title
	desc = {
		desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_header
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_mode_off
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_mode_mild
			}
			desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_mode_historic
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_lia_active
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_lia_done
			}
			desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_lia_idle
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_silver_active
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active }
				desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_silver_tide
			}
			desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_silver_idle
		}
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				OR = {
					oe_cri2_w1_granary_active = yes
					oe_cri2_w1_coinage_active = yes
				}
			}
			desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_w1_syn
		}
		desc = oe_cri2.16.desc_footer
	}
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cri2_rebel_charter.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_cri2.16.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cri2.16.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_cri2_set_mode_historic = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cri2.16.c
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_cri2_set_mode_mild = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cri2.16.d
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_cri2_set_mode_off = yes
	}
}
